attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Minnesota corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Minnesota Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false result.mn_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts)
condition_details.condition_description: result.mn_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.mn_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no filing required false result.mn_has_nexus xdef 0.0 result.mn_tax_liability xdef "Minnesota filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Minnesota state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. MN generally conforms to IRC with some modifications.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Minnesota Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.mn_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.mn_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Minnesota state additions and subtractions

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 result.mn_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.mn_state_subtractions xdef "Minnesota adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Minnesota corporate income tax. Applies Minnesota flat rate (9.5%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Minnesota Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.mn_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.mn_tax_liability xdef

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: // No taxable income - no tax liability 0.0 result.mn_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.mn_tax_liability xdef result.mn_estimated_payments result.mn_refund_or_owed xdef "Minnesota tax liability: $0 (no taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto

// No nexus - no tax liability 0.0 result.mn_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.mn_tax_liability xdef result.mn_estimated_payments result.mn_refund_or_owed xdef "Minnesota tax liability: $0 (no nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto
